description: AI Rules Engine - Layer 4 (Glyph Activation & Keywords) - Ultra-detailed validation system

4.1_GLYPH_ACTIVATION_MECHANICS.description: Core rules for how glyphs are activated and resolve

4.1.1_activation_requirements.description: Conditions that must be met to activate a glyph

requirements.validation: target exists AND target is valid (self/opponent/none as required)

requirements.error: You are Silenced and cannot activate glyphs

requirements.validation: If glyph requires specific Neural State, player must be in that state
requirements.example: Gamma-exclusive glyphs require Gamma State active
requirements.error: Must be in {required_state} to activate this glyph

4.1.1.1_silence_mechanics.removal: Can be cleansed by ally or expires naturally
4.1.1.1_silence_mechanics.exception: Certain ultimate glyphs can 'break through' Silence (marked as [Unsilenceable])

4.1.2_targeting_rules.description: How targeting works for different glyph types

targeting_types.description: Affects only the casting player's card

targeting_types.UI: Player must click target before confirming glyph

process: If targeting required, highlight valid targets
System validates target matches glyph requirements
If valid, proceed to cost payment

4.1.2.2_invalid_target_handling.description: What happens if target becomes invalid mid-activation
4.1.2.2_invalid_target_handling.edge_case: Rare, but if target state changes between selection and resolution
4.1.2.2_invalid_target_handling.resolution: Glyph fizzles, costs not consumed, no cooldown applied
4.1.2.2_invalid_target_handling.example: Opponent enters Theta State (immune) after you target them → Glyph canceled

sequence.name: declaration
sequence.description: Player declares glyph activation and selects target (if required)
sequence.note: Player can cancel here without penalty

sequence.name: effect_resolution
sequence.description: Apply glyph's primary effect (damage, heal, buff, etc.)
sequence.order: Primary effect → Secondary effects → Triggered effects

sequence.name: synergy_triggers
sequence.description: Check for synergy conditions and trigger related effects
examples: Character Analysis: If prediction correct → Bonus effects
Consciousness: If in Gamma State → Double activation

sequence.name: counter_reactions
sequence.timing: After primary effect resolves, before turn ends

sequence.name: cooldown_application
sequence.description: If glyph has cooldown, start counting from this turn

sequence.name: state_update
sequence.description: Update all game state (HP, resources, status effects, etc.)
sequence.validation: Ensure all values within valid ranges

4.1.3.1_fizzle_conditions.description: Glyph can fizzle (fail to resolve) under certain conditions
4.1.3.1_fizzle_conditions.fizzle_result: Costs still consumed, cooldown still applied, but no effect occurs

4.1.4_cooldown_mechanics.cooldown_definition: Number of turns that must pass before glyph can be used again
cooldown_ranges: No cooldown: Basic glyphs (can spam every turn if resources available)
Very long cooldown (8-10 turns): Game-changing abilities

cooldown_tracking.start: Cooldown begins after glyph activation (step 6 of activation sequence)
cooldown_tracking.countdown: Cooldown reduces by 1 at START_OF_TURN phase
cooldown_tracking.ready: When cooldown reaches 0, glyph is available again

cooldown_reduction.effect: Reduce cooldown of another glyph by 1-2 turns
examples: Foundational: Reset (reduces cooldowns of defensive glyphs)
Consciousness: Neural Acceleration (reduces all cooldowns by 1)

cooldown_reduction.effect: Correct prediction → Reduce random glyph cooldown by 1

4.1.4.1_cooldown_reset_mechanics.description: Certain glyphs can reset cooldowns entirely
glyphs: Invocation: Miracle Reset (resets all cooldowns, once per match)
Singularity: Pattern Reset (resets 1 glyph cooldown when pattern detected)

4.1.4.2_cooldown_display.display: Number badge on glyph icon showing turns remaining
4.1.4.2_cooldown_display.color_coding: Red = on cooldown, Green = ready to use

4.2_KEYWORD_SYSTEM.description: Comprehensive definitions of all glyph keywords

[Strike].interaction: Cannot pierce [Shield], must break shield first

synergies: Tantra engine: +1 Prana per turn per [Burn] stack
Certain glyphs deal bonus damage to burning targets
[Burn].removal: [Cleanse] effects, Therapeutic healing can remove 1 stack

[Detonate].description: Consume [Burn] stacks for immediate massive damage

[Exposed].description: Target takes +50% increased damage from all sources
[Exposed].synergy: Combo with high-damage glyphs for burst

[Silence].effect: Target cannot activate any glyph (automatic pass turn)
[Silence].removal: Expires naturally or specific cleanse glyphs
[Silence].powerful: Extremely strong debuff, rare and expensive

[Stun].effect: Target loses entire turn (no glyph activation, no resource generation)

[Shield].description: Absorb damage before HP is lost
[Shield].damage_absorption: Shield absorbs damage first, excess damage carries to HP
[Shield].example: 30 shield, 50 damage incoming → Shield depleted, 20 damage to HP
synergies: Foundational engine: Structure cap overflow → Auto [Shield]
[Shield].removal: Damaged until depleted, or certain glyphs dispel shields

[Sanctify].description: Grant holy state with damage reduction and immunity to [Curse]
[Sanctify].removal: Expires naturally or specific dispel effects

[Counter].description: Reactive glyph that triggers during opponent's turn
[Counter].activation_timing: After opponent's glyph resolves, before turn ends
trigger_conditions: When opponent uses specific glyph type
[Counter].cost: Usually cheaper than normal glyphs (1-2 KP)
examples: Invocation: Divine Retribution (holy damage when attacked)

counter_activation.description: Player must have [Counter] glyph ready (not on cooldown)
counter_activation.resource_check: Must have sufficient resources to activate counter

[Heal].overheal: No (capped at max HP, unless temporary HP granted)
[Heal].synergy: Generates Grace Points (+1 Grace per 20 HP healed)

[Regen].removal: Expires naturally or can be dispelled

[Immunity].description: Complete immunity to all damage and debuffs
[Immunity].effect: Take 0 damage, immune to all negative status effects
[Immunity].restriction: Usually cannot attack while immune (defensive only)
[Immunity].rare: Extremely powerful, very rare and expensive
[Immunity].counterplay: Wait out duration, focus on resource generation

[Forecast].description: Make prediction about opponent's next action

[Convert].description: Convert one resource type to another

[Cleanse].removes: 1 debuff per activation (player choice which one)
[Cleanse].upgraded_cleanse: Some glyphs remove all debuffs (mass cleanse)
[Cleanse].strategic: Save for critical debuffs like [Silence] or heal block

[Dispel].description: Remove positive buffs from opponent (offensive cleanse)

[Collapse].trigger: When specific pattern conditions met + Coherence at cap
[Collapse].effect: Instant round victory (opponent HP reduced to 0)
[Collapse].counterplay: Randomize actions, break patterns, deny Coherence generation

[Checkmate].trigger: Predict opponent's next 3 actions correctly in a row
[Checkmate].counterplay: Mix up strategy, avoid predictable patterns

[Anchor].effect: Target's resources and stats cannot be stolen, denied, or reduced
[Anchor].strategic: Use before opponent's resource disruption turn

[Reaction].description: Glyphs that activate during opponent's turn
types: When opponent casts specific glyph type → Counter
[Reaction].note: Player must have resources available for reaction to trigger

[Neural_State].effect: Each state grants different bonuses and restrictions

state_benefits.Gamma: +8 Bandwidth/turn, glyphs activate twice (second at 50% potency)

[Neural_State].strategic: Choose state based on situation (offense vs defense)

[Grace_Scaling].description: Effect scales with accumulated Grace Points
examples: All Invocation healing and damage glyphs
[Grace_Scaling].strategic: Accumulate Grace for late-game power spike

4.3_KEYWORD_INTERACTIONS.description: How keywords interact with each other

4.3.1_buff_debuff_interactions.description: Priority rules when buffs and debuffs conflict

examples.resolution: Both exist, [Bless] +20% healing, [Curse] -50% healing → Net -30% healing

4.3.2_damage_shield_interaction.sequence: Damage → [Shield] absorption → Remaining damage to HP

examples.resolution: Shields stack additively, 50 total shield value

4.3.2_damage_shield_interaction.true_damage_interaction: True damage (from [Burn], certain ultimates) bypasses [Shield] entirely

4.3.3_status_cleanse_interaction.player_choice: Player chooses which effect to cleanse if multiple present
4.3.3_status_cleanse_interaction.dispel_vs_cleanse: [Dispel] removes opponent buffs, [Cleanse] removes ally debuffs

synergies.effect: Stack [Burn] then [Detonate] for massive burst damage
Apply [Exposed] then use high-damage [Strike] for +50% damage
[Reveal] opponent's next glyph, then [Forecast] for guaranteed correct prediction
synergies.bonus: Free glyph activation from correct prediction

synergies.effect: Shield absorbs initial damage, [Sanctify] reduces damage to shield → Extended shield duration
[Bless] generates Grace, Grace amplifies next Invocation glyphs

4.4.1_synergy_triggers.description: When one glyph triggers bonuses for another

trigger_types.description: Using multiple glyphs from same engine in sequence
trigger_types.example: 3 Tantra glyphs in a row → 4th Tantra glyph +20% damage
trigger_types.engines: All engines have some form of combo bonus

trigger_types.description: Character Analysis correct prediction triggers bonuses

sequence: [Counter] deals retaliatory damage back to Player A
Player A's [Reaction] to taking damage triggers (if they have one)
Chain continues until no more reactions trigger

4.4.3_combo_tracking.description: System tracks glyph usage patterns for combo bonuses
tracked_patterns: Same engine used consecutively (2, 3, 4+ in a row)
4.4.3_combo_tracking.combo_break: Using different pattern breaks combo counter
4.4.3_combo_tracking.UI_indicator: Combo counter displayed on screen (e.g., '3-Hit Combo!')

VALIDATION_FRAMEWORK.description: How AI validates glyph and keyword actions

validation_process.validation: Check activation requirements (R-4.1.1): resources, cooldown, targeting, silenced
Check targeting type matches glyph requirements (R-4.1.2)
Follow 7-step sequence (R-4.1.3): declaration → cost → effect → synergies → counters → cooldown → state
Resolve keywords per definitions (4.2.1-4.2.4), check interactions (4.3.1-4.3.4)
Check synergy triggers (R-4.4.1), reaction chains (R-4.4.2), combo tracking (R-4.4.3)
Ensure HP, resources, status effects, cooldowns all within valid ranges

error_messages.silenced: You are Silenced and cannot activate glyphs!
error_messages.state_requirement_not_met: Must be in {required_state} to use this glyph
